title: Property-tax breaks and taxes diverted to arena debt

rows.tax_break_notes: IBO (July 11, 2023): "more than $946.7 million (in 2023 dollars)" forgone, an estimate that "dates back to 1984 and not to 1982" and covers FY1984-FY2023 (full report p.9), converted to 2026 dollars from 2023; plus the Department of Finance's tax-expenditure values for FY2024 $42.2M, FY2025 $42.9M and FY2026 $43.3M (Annual Reports on Tax Expenditures), each converted from its year
rows.property_tax_status: Exempt by state law since 1982; DOF: $42.4M forgone in FY2023, $43.3M in FY2026 (FY2023 FMV $867M)

rows.pilot_note: Tax-exempt PILOT bonds (2009; refunded 2016 as $478.7M tax-exempt + $15M taxable) repaid from PILOTs in lieu of property tax (would-be tax $99M vs PILOT $39M in 2023 per IBO). Counted only in the expanded total.
rows.property_tax_status: Exempt (state LDC owns); PILOTs $39M (2023) service arena bonds; would-be tax $99M (IBO 2023); DOF FY2027 MV $2.54B

rows.tax_break_desc: 1989 stadium valuation formula (P.A. 86-110; 35 ILCS 200/10-205 to 10-220), tax years through 2016 (end inferred)
rows.tax_break_notes: Taxes forgone 2002-2016 at the first post-formula assessment ($32.31M AV, 2017) x each year's equalizer and rate, minus taxes paid: $46.6M nominal (a, from Assessor, PTAXSIM and IDOR data); $36.1M at the 2021 market value; about $77M if extended to 1994-2001 (rough); a floor because 1994-2001 inputs were not reachable
rows.property_tax_status: Taxable; 2024 AV mailed $125.0M -> certified $92.1M -> BOR $50.3M; est. tax ~$10.4M (a); Treasurer: $10.8M paid in 2024 incl. the adjacent Advocate Center (b)

rows.tax_break_desc: Exemption from the Facilities Development Admissions ("seat") tax (1997 Arena Agreement s.5.7); 10% under the current code (DRMC 53-306, 2020), 1997 rate not confirmed
rows.tax_break_notes: Memo, not added: about $4M a year at McNichols (c, 9News; page returned 403, quote from search index only) x 24 seasons of the agreement's Operation Term (1999-2023) = $96M nominal (a); range $28M (7 seasons, to the end of the Nuggets' McNichols lease) to $108M (27 seasons to date)
rows.property_tax_status: Building privately owned on city-owned land during a 23-year ground lease ($10 a year); property-tax increment paid back to the developer through DURA (the counted $36.5M TIF, repaid 2016)

rows.tax_break_desc: Real-property & possessory-interest tax exemption since construction, continued to June 2050 by the 2024 arena law (+ FY2025 deed transfer/recordation abatements)
rows.tax_break_notes: OCFO: $49.8M FY2025-28 + $262.9M FY2029-50; OCFO found the abatement not financially necessary
rows.property_tax_status: District-owned; $0 tax 2016-2026 on $524-528M assessment; OCFO values the continued exemption at ~$10.0M/yr (FY2026) and all relief in the 2024 law at $312.7M FY2025-2050

method: select a.team, a.arena, a.tax_break_desc, a.tax_break_annual_m, a.tax_break_annual_year, a.tax_break_annual_2026_m, a.tax_break_cumulative_nominal_m, a.tax_break_cumulative_2026_m, a.tax_break_in_expanded_total, a.tax_break_future_committed_m, a.tax_break_memo_estimate_m, a.tax_break_notes, a.pilot_or_tax_diversion_financing_m, a.pilot_2026_m, a.pilot_note, a.property_tax_status, coalesce((select list(s.source_id order by s.field, s.ord) from arena_sources s where s.row_type = 'current_arena' and s.team = a.team and s.field in ('tax_break_source', 'property_tax_source')), []) as sources from arenas a where a.tax_break_desc is not null or a.pilot_2026_m is not null order by coalesce(a.tax_break_cumulative_2026_m, 0) + coalesce(a.pilot_2026_m, 0) desc, a.team
